objective: Learn the exact storage-neutral SwiGLU diagonal gauge from hard-CQ3 activation error on 32 frozen layer-59 rows, then require improvement on the untouched interleaved 32-row confirmation split.

parent_finding.mechanics: The exact gauge, code-preserving scale fold, storage neutrality, and topology-conditioned down training all executed successfully.
parent_finding.negative: A fixed source-column-RMS gauge improved complete-MLP NMSE by only 0.33411777734710262 percent and missed its gate.
parent_finding.next_hypothesis: The available gauge freedom must align with activation-weighted hard-quantization error rather than source-weight RMS.

scope.selection_reason: same worst-down-projection layer as v71; no layer reselection after observing v71

gauge_optimization.algebra: up_prime = D up; down_prime = down D^-1
gauge_optimization.parameterization: 17408 FP32 log-gauge values initialized to zero; training-only
gauge_optimization.hard_forward: CQ3 optimal ternary codes and scales recomputed for each 128-row down shard at every outer step
gauge_optimization.gradient: straight-through gradient through the hard CQ3 down weight and both appearances of D
gauge_optimization.objective: sum of normalized squared complete down-projection error on training rows plus log-gauge L2
gauge_optimization.global_scale_fix: subtract median log D after each optimizer step
gauge_optimization.selection: lowest hard-CQ3 training NMSE among step 0 through 12

down_training.method: activation-aware row-sharded hard-forward straight-through CQ3 training after freezing D

decision.if_pass: promote activation-learned gauge training to a preregistered multilayer set without changing the learned representation
decision.if_fail: reject the diagonal-gauge family at layer 59 and move to a richer block-local correction or mixed-bit sensitive-mode treatment

claim_boundary: Frozen train-confirmation layer-59 calibration pilot only. A pass cannot establish whole-model capability, perplexity, MATH, code, MMLU, throughput, energy, novelty, 100 tokens per second, or a scientific breakthrough.
